summary: Close SQLite index connections and preserve busy rebuild owners

delivery.outcome: Close every internal SQLite index connection deterministically on success, failure and connection setup exceptions; treat SQLite BUSY/LOCKED rebuild failures as bounded contention without resetting another writer's index, while retaining genuine corruption recovery.
nonGoals: No live database/lock deletion, live package hotpatch, owner termination, lease takeover or automatic reservation release.
No claim that a source fix or isolated canary is native runtime activation; prior publication exceptions remain separate.

architecture.decision: Give the existing SQLiteTicketIndex internal operation context deterministic transaction exit and close, close failed setup connections, and share exact SQLite contention classification with the store rebuild/post-commit paths.
architecture.rollback: Revert the source commit; native artifacts/activation require separate exact-target operator receipts.

validation.evidence: Repeated reads release connections without cyclic GC; successful transaction/rollback/setup failures release resources.
Independent SQLite writer retains PID/inode/data on BUSY/LOCKED; extended SQLite codes and Python3.10 fallback handled; real corruption recovery retained.

commands: protected OneDev exact-head/current-base verification and independent Validator publication
isolated installed-wheel canary on live native base image without live volume/network
